main_text.l: Macedonia enim fuerat diu præda occupantium, & miserè cùm ab externis hostibus, tùm civium discordiis distracta, donec Antigonus, Genatas[?], ex posteritate Alexandri, eam recuperaret. Ultimus Regum fuit Perseus à Romanis debellatus.
Syria defectione Parthorum, Bactrianorum, Indorum, Armeniorum, Medorum, Iudæorum, Arabum, debilitata fuit.
Familiæ regum Syriæ Seleuci-dæ vocantur, a SeleucoNicanore, qui primus post Alexandrum Syriam & totum Orientem in suâ potestate habuit, usque quo ipsius posteri dome-sticis

page.notes: The right edge shows the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. "Genatas" is read as printed; it is probably Gonatas, so it is marked [?]. The final word "sticis" was broken as "dome-" / "sticis" at the line end and is kept with its printed hyphen.
